sql:
WITH tagged_tickets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.id AS ticket_id, t.tenant_id, t.created_at, t.resolved_at
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN ticket_tags_map ttm ON ttm.ticket_id = t.id AND ttm.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  JOIN support_tags st ON st.id = ttm.support_tag_id AND st.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
  JOIN tenants te ON te.id = t.tenant_id
  WHERE te.name IN ('Marrowby & Vane','Studio Vrij','Cragsley Outfitters')
    AND st.name IN ('delivery','where-is-my-order')
    AND t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
breaches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ticket_id FROM sla_breaches WHERE breach_kind = 'resolution'
)
SELECT
  te.name AS tenant_name,
  strftime(date_trunc('month', tt.created_at), '%Y-%m') AS month_label,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tt.resolved_at - tt.created_at))/60) FILTER (WHERE tt.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.ticket_id IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) AS resolution_breach_rate
FROM tagged_tickets tt
JOIN tenants te ON te.id = tt.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN breaches b ON b.ticket_id = tt.ticket_id
GROUP BY te.name, date_trunc('month', tt.created_at)
ORDER BY te.name, month_label
note: avg_resolution_minutes is computed only over tickets that have a resolved_at timestamp (unresolved tickets in a month are excluded from that average but still counted in ticket_count and the breach-rate denominator); resolution_breach_rate is the share of that month's tagged tickets with at least one sla_breaches row of breach_kind='resolution'.
